sentences.text: This petition is filed claiming a direction to the appropriate authority to pay appropriate compensation to the petitioners at the current market rate of the land and not at the rate which was prevailing 20 years back.

Shri Jitendra Shrivastava, learned Panel Lawyer submits that notice for land acquisition was issued and, thereafter, compensation was offered to the petitioners but they refused to accept the compensation in the year 1981 as is evident from Annexure R-1.
Thus, after having refused the compensation, petitioners are not entitled to claim enhanced compensation which was in terms of the scheme of the Land Acquisition Act, 1984.
Compensation is to be paid as on the date of issuance of the notification for land acquisition and not on any subsequent date.
Therefore, petition is devoid of merits, deserves to be dismissed.
Copy of award as was passed by the Land Acquisition Officer on 31.08.1979 is available on record as Annexure R-4.
It is evident from the award that notification was issued prior to 1979.

Thus, once award was passed and the same was not challenged before the competent authority then the petitioners are bound by the terms and conditions of the award and they cannot claim any additional benefit after having refused to accept the compensation in time.
In view of above, petition being devoid of merits, deserves to be and is hereby dismissed.
(VIVEK AGARWAL) JUDGE pp Sheikh Ajij vs The State Of M.P. on 14 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/90346526/
